title: UK ETS aviation improvement-report QA controls

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for aviation: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: An improvement report is required when a verification report recommends improvements.
facts.expected_handling: Create the task only when the verifier trigger exists.

facts.source_fact: An improvement report is also required when verification identifies non-conformities with the EMP.
METS automatically generates an improvement-report task when the trigger is present.
The improvement report is due by 30 June in the year the annual emissions report was submitted.
facts.expected_handling: Bind deadline to the report-submission year.

facts.source_fact: The report must describe how and when identified non-conformities will be addressed.
The report must describe how and when recommended improvements will be implemented.
Addressing improvements may require a variation to the EMP.
facts.expected_handling: Route material methodology changes through EMP variation.

facts.source_fact: An operator may explain that an improvement would cause unreasonable costs or not improve methodology.
facts.expected_handling: Do not silently reject verifier recommendations.

facts.source_fact: Reasons for not implementing a recommended improvement must be supported with evidence.
An improvement report is an operator compliance task and does not prove browser or parcel acceptance.

guard_patterns.handling: Require verifier recommendation or non-conformity trigger.
Link each action to verifier finding.
Route relevant changes through EMP variation.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
